verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical and share the same flaws. The SOLSTICE wordmark floats right of centre while the headline and body copy are left-aligned. The badges and CTA hug the right edge, so they don't line up with the copy. The two badges almost touch each other and are crammed right under the body copy, which breaks the grid. A sits too high, with a thin top margin and dead space at the bottom; B moves the whole stack down for slightly better vertical balance, but its circle presses closer to the wordmark.
